name: Cheesy Black Bean-Polenta Stacks with Salsa & Creamy Avocado Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Slice polenta crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Divide polenta between the baking sheets, arranging the slices in a single layer.
Place polenta in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) while you prepare the beans.
Drain and rinse beans; place in a large bowl, season with chili powder and salt, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans black beans
1 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheets from the oven. Spoon seasoned beans over the polenta slices, then top with cheese. (Reserve bowl for the coleslaw.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Return baking sheets to the oven and bake until polenta stacks are warmed through and cheese is melted, 7 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice limes into the reserved bowl. Add guacamole, yogurt, and salt; stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ cups guacamole
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add cabbage to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine the slaw.
To serve, divide polenta stacks and slaw between plates. Top polenta stacks with salsa and enjoy!
